summary: iter251 E2E frontend test for UserFunctionsDialog.applyTemplate bug fix (Spanish user report: quick templates overwrote previously-granted staff permissions). Tested all 4 requested flows end-to-end against employee.test@resilience.com via admin session cookie test_session_admin_X on the preview URL. All flows PASSED — the fix correctly performs a UNION of pending/current permissions with template permissions instead of replacing.

test_results_detail.smoke_ui: PASS - the 3 templates (Cajero, Mensajería, Inventario) are rendered under staff-templates with descriptions all starting with 'Suma:'.
test_results_detail.toast_wording: PASS - toast text is exactly 'Plantilla «Cajero» aplicada (permisos sumados).' (and analogous for Mensajería).
test_results_detail.flujo_principal_cajero: PASS - starting from allowed_permissions=['support'], allowed_currencies=['USD']; after clicking Cajero + confirming TOTP, MongoDB shows allowed_permissions == UNION {support, orders, withdrawals, company_funds, quick_view} (support preserved — bug fixed) and allowed_currencies == [] (all currencies, as cajero.currencies=[]).
test_results_detail.flujo_viceversa_mensajeria: PASS - starting from allowed_permissions=['orders','quick_view'], allowed_currencies=['USD','USDT']; after clicking Mensajería + TOTP, MongoDB shows allowed_permissions == {orders, quick_view, deliveries} (nothing lost) and allowed_currencies unchanged == ['USD','USDT'] (mensajería.currencies=['__NONE__'] preserves current currencies).
test_results_detail.manual_after_template: PASS - starting from {orders, quick_view, deliveries} (post-mensajería state), opened granular popover, toggled 'users' permission, saved with TOTP; MongoDB shows {orders, quick_view, deliveries, users} — template perms preserved plus the newly added manual one.

critical_code_review_comments: applyTemplate correctly reads pendingPerms/pendingCurrencies before falling back to user.allowed_permissions/allowed_currencies, so unsaved selections aren't lost when a template is applied. Good.

Minor: applyTemplate calls putUserFields without a TOTP code; backend returns TOTP_CODE_REQUIRED and TotpPromptDialog opens correctly. Confirmed the retry path (pendingTotp.fields) resends the merged fields — no double-merge risk since applyTemplate itself is not re-called.

Minor UX (not blocking): after a successful template apply, the parent onUserUpdated refreshes user.allowed_permissions. If admin immediately clicks a SECOND template without the parent state having propagated to props, the merge will still be correct because pendingPerms is set null on success and the next click reads user.allowed_permissions from the fresh response. Verified via re-open flow.

rca of the issue: Original bug: applyTemplate previously called putUserFields({allowed_permissions: tpl.perms, allowed_currencies: tpl.currencies}), fully REPLACING existing values. Any prior permission (e.g. 'support') not in the template was wiped. Fix (iter251): merge pendingPerms/user.allowed_permissions with tpl.perms via new Set() union; for currencies use sentinel logic — [] means 'all' (replace), ['__NONE__'] means 'don't touch', otherwise union. Verified: 'support' preserved after Cajero; ['USD','USDT'] preserved after Mensajería.
